name: Shimei
overview: Shimei is a male biblical figure identified as a descendant of Bani. His unique attribute is that he had married a foreign wife, a detail recorded in Ezra 10:38. No specific tribe or additional notes are provided about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Shimei means 'YHWH has heard' or 'famous.' This proper name, mentioned in Ezra 10:38, reflects a Hebrew origin but was not given directly by God according to the record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Shimei is a descendant of Bani, as noted in Ezra 10:38. Beyond this lineage, no further family relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Shimei's significance in the biblical narrative centers on his status as a descendant of Bani who had taken a foreign wife. This detail is part of the larger context in Ezra 10, where the issue of intermarriage with foreign women was addressed among the returned exiles. His mention highlights the challenges faced by Israel in maintaining covenantal purity during the post-exilic period.
